europe_now.title: SpaceX and Blue Origin withdraw from French space summit
europe_now.summary: Major US space companies SpaceX and Blue Origin have withdrawn from a French space summit following pressure from the White House. The cancellation highlights the growing friction between US and European priorities in the space sector.

europe_now.title: Slovakia rejects EU plan to lock in Russia sanctions
europe_now.summary: Slovakia has rejected a European Union proposal to extend its sanctions against Russia for an additional twelve months. The rejection underscores the ongoing divisions within the bloc regarding the long-term enforcement of measures against Moscow.

top_stories.title: German far-right rise accelerates EU budget deal push
top_stories.summary: The rising influence of the far-right in Germany is accelerating the European Union's push toward a two-trillion-euro budget deal. This political shift highlights the urgent need for EU leaders to secure funding amid changing domestic political landscapes.

top_stories.title: Volkswagen plans major job cuts amid global competition
top_stories.summary: Volkswagen plans to eliminate an additional 50,000 jobs as it struggles to compete with Chinese manufacturers and navigate international tariffs. The move signals a significant challenge for Germany's automotive sector and its broader economy.

top_stories.title: US demands reimbursement for Ukraine munitions
top_stories.summary: Former US President Donald Trump has stated that he would ask European nations to reimburse the United States for munitions sent to Ukraine. This proposal has raised concerns about the future of transatlantic security cooperation and funding for Kyiv.

top_stories.title: Volkswagen Job Cuts
top_stories.summary: Volkswagen announced plans to eliminate 50,000 jobs in response to mounting pressure from international tariffs and heightened Chinese competition. The sweeping cuts reflect broader industrial challenges facing major European automakers in the current global market.
